issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other 192,680.71 (p1; incl. TIFF XX599 61,080.88 and NPAIT 1,205.99 on p4)
issues.issue: Very large 'other' line (61% of receipts excluding transfers). Page 4 prints the TIFF fund's share, 61,080.88, which is tax-increment receipts (property tax) passed through to Community Development. That share could be split out by fund column with split_from. Left whole with review.

Lines are printed under 'Business-Type Activities' but paid from the General Fund (and 5.00 from Sewer Reserve). They are kept governmental because there is no separate enterprise statement, and the Water/Sewer Reserve and Water Deposit funds are also treated as governmental. Defensible, but fund type needs a human call.

beginning_cash/ending_cash are the line 3/line 28 subtotals, which already include the investments (62,256.73 / 20,936.56). The separate investments fields would double count if added to cash. The roll-forward is correct.

No balance sheet in the waiver. One was built from the ending-balance lines, with labels changed slightly ('(ending)' added). County treasurer balance 7,324.61 left out. The revised page 1 (stamped 2/20/26) and page 7 were used correctly; crossed-out pages 2, 3 and 8 were rightly ignored.
